Cat Island, Japan 🐈

On Tashirojima, in Miyagi Prefecture, cats outnumber people—and locals wouldn’t have it any other way. The island’s residents believe cats bring good fortune and prosperity, especially when they’re well fed and cared for.

Most of the cats roam freely, but they’re treated with kindness. Meanwhile, the human population has dwindled from around 1,000 to fewer than 100 over the past 50 years.

Dogs are banned to protect the cats, and a small shrine honors a cat that was accidentally killed. Today, the island’s feline reputation is drawing tourists—and may be bringing Tashirojima a little luck of its own.
